note: Shared research-compound catalogue. Prices in CAD per vial. COMPLIANCE TRIAGE APPLIED 2026-08-16 (branch compliance/remediation-2026-08-16). Every product carries `disposition` (DELIST|FIX), `disposition_basis` and `disposition_note`. DELIST rows are set active=false and must not be seeded, rendered or sold; their URLs return 410. `disposition_basis: minimum` = the operator's own non-negotiable delist criteria (GLP-1/GIP class, Canadian Prescription Drug List, reconstitution supplies) - 12 SKUs. `disposition_basis: independent` = recommended additionally by the remediation review - 18 SKUs; these are reversible by counsel, one field each. NO product is marked KEEP. Every remaining SKU is FIX and is NOT sellable today: none has a purity result, a CAS/formula/molecular weight on record, or a certificate of analysis. purity stays blank everywhere - no analysis is held that would substantiate a figure, and a stated purity reads as a measured result. 'was' is the pre-discount reference price; 'cost' is a PLACEHOLDER landed cost and must be replaced with the real per-vial supplier cost before margin figures mean anything.
